headline: Operations Leader, Process Change and AI Tools
profile: Operations leader with 15 years in live events and broadcast, most recently Head of Esports Operations at BLAST, where I led a six-person department through a rebuild of how it works: clearer ownership, accountability and proper documentation. I designed and built the department's own operations tools, and in 2026 used Claude Code to build the Esports Ops Suite, web tools on Airtable to replace the team's Google Sheets, tested alongside the existing sheets with freelancers and internal staff. I also scoped an AI vision system for a live event, covering methods, privacy and rollout. I'm used to working with finance, product and commercial teams, training crews on new kit and workflows, and getting people to change how they work because the new way is genuinely easier.
